commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a bounded MiniMax OAuth request timeout to the device-code and token-poll guarded fetches and adds loopback regression tests for hanging responses.

PR surface: Source +16, Tests +250. Total +266 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible. Current main has no per-request timeout on the two MiniMax OAuth guarded fetches, and the PR's loopback tests demonstrate the affected hanging-response path with a bounded timeout.

target.title: fix(minimax): add timeouts to OAuth HTTP requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

MiniMax OAuth login could wait indefinitely when either the device-code request or token-poll request accepted the HTTP connection but never returned a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OAuth flow already has bounded polling and expiry behavior, but each individual outbound HTTP request lacked its own deadline. This change applies one request timeout through both the fetch guard and OAuth abort-signal helper, while preserving the existing PKCE payloads, SSRF hostname policy, error-body limits, and polling loop behavior.

## User Impact

A stalled MiniMax OAuth endpoint no longer leaves the login flow wedged. Authorization-code and token-poll hangs now reject boundedly instead of waiting forever.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/minimax/oauth.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  14 passed (14)`.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/minimax/oauth.ts extensions/minimax/oauth.test.ts` - passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/minimax/oauth.ts extensions/minimax/oauth.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check upstream/main..HEAD` - passed; exit 0.
- Open PR collision check: searched open PR topics and scanned the latest 500 open PR changed-file lists; no open PR touched `extensions/minimax/oauth.ts`.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: MiniMax OAuth code and token POSTs now have deadlines when the remote endpoint accepts the request but never sends a response.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that accepts requests and deliberately never responds. The regression first verifies a bare fetch to the same hanging server remains pending without a deadline.

Exact command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/minimax/oauth.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused tests drive the exported `loginMiniMaxPortalOAuth` path for both the authorization-code request and token-poll request. Each path reaches the local hanging server, carries an `AbortSignal`, and rejects with an abort/timeout-class error within the bounded window.

What was not tested: live MiniMax OAuth traffic; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
